```python
# Minimal FastAPI example for creating/updating a CAPA
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()

class CAPA(BaseModel):
    id: str
    evidence_links: list[str]
    contract_version: str
    tenants: list[str]
    status: str

@app.post('/capa')
def create_capa(capa: CAPA):
    # persist CAPA and attach logs/ traces
    return {"status": "created", "capa_id": capa.id}
```
